Our client is an international online gaming company focused on delivering engaging and innovative gaming experiences, leveraging modern technologies to provide high-quality products and services for a global audience.

Perfect for those who aim to:

  • Manage and grow the product’s social media presence across Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), and Telegram, adapting content to target markets and GEOs;

  • Create engaging content using AI tools, including the generation of AI models, characters, images, and videos;

  • Develop and execute content calendars aligned with iGaming campaigns, promotions, tournaments, seasonal events, and key industry trends;

  • Produce and adapt UGC-style and native content formats optimized for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts;

  • Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, and emerging content opportunities within the iGaming space;

  • Collaborate closely with designers and the branding team to ensure consistent visual identity and messaging across all channels;

  • Support audience growth, engagement, and brand awareness initiatives through creative and data-driven content strategies;

  • Continuously test new content formats, creative concepts, and AI-driven workflows to improve performance and efficiency.

Experience you’ll need to bring:

  • At least 1 year of experience in Social Media Marketing (SMM);

  • Experience in iGaming, betting, or casino projects is a strong advantage;

  • Familiarity with social media platform policies and restrictions related to iGaming, with the ability to operate effectively within compliance constraints;

  • Strong visual taste and an understanding of creative trends that resonate with iGaming audiences;

  • Ability to adapt content strategies for different GEOs, audience segments, and traffic channels;

  • Hands-on experience with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion) for creating AI models and visual assets;

  • Proficiency in AI video tools (Kling, Runway, Hailuo) and LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude) for copywriting, ideation, and creative brief development.

It's a perfect match if you have those personal features:

  • A creative mindset with a strong eye for visual storytelling, internet culture, memes, and social media trends;

  • Genuine passion for AI tools and emerging tech, backed by a drive to continuously experiment and learn;

  • A data-driven approach with the ability to balance out-of-the-box creativity with performance goals;

  • Strong attention to detail with a high bar for content quality and brand consistency;

  • Solid organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously;

  • Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment;

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with designers, marketers, and cross-functional teams.

Our clients offer competitive benefits to support your professional and personal growth, including:

  • Health & Wellness Focus;

  • Global Medical Coverage;

  • Growth Opportunities;

  • Benefits Programs (compensation for the gym/stomatology/psychological service

  • Performance-Driven Rewards;

  • Dynamic Work Environment.

Apply, and let your growth journey begin.
